title: Samsung Galaxy S21 5G
features: The base Galaxy S21 5G has a 6.2-inch FHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with an adaptive refresh rate up to 120 Hz, a 4,000 mAh typical battery, and a 10 MP front camera. The rear cameras are 12 MP wide, 12 MP ultrawide, and 64 MP telephoto.

title: Fitbit Charge 4
features: This wrist-worn fitness tracker can record steps, heart rate, sleep, and workouts. It has built-in GPS for tracking pace and distance on supported outdoor activities.
usage: Wear it on your wrist, pair it with the Fitbit app, and sync it to review your activity and sleep. Start an exercise on the tracker to record a workout.
visual_note: Similar fitness trackers can look alike. Check the model in the Fitbit app or on the device to confirm.

title: KitchenAid Artisan Stand Mixer
features: The standard Artisan Series KSM150PS is a 5-quart tilt-head stand mixer. Included accessories include a flat beater, dough hook, and wire whip. Optional pasta and food grinder attachments fit the hub and are sold separately.
usage: Use the flat beater to mix batter, the dough hook to knead bread dough, and the wire whip to whip cream or egg whites.
visual_note: Check the model label to confirm the exact variant. Other KitchenAid tilt-head mixers have a similar shape.

title: Amazon Echo Dot (3rd generation)
features: The 3rd-generation Echo Dot is a compact Alexa smart speaker with a 1.6-inch driver, Bluetooth connectivity, and a wired audio output.
usage: Ask Alexa to play music or control compatible smart-home devices.
source_name: Amazon official Echo Dot launch details

title: Google Nest Mini (2nd generation)
features: Google introduced the Nest Mini as a Google Assistant smart speaker. It has a 40 mm driver with 360-degree sound, Bluetooth 5.0, and dual-band Wi-Fi.
usage: Use voice commands to listen to music and control compatible smart-home devices in the Google Home ecosystem.
source_name: Google official Nest Mini technical specifications

title: Apple AirPods Pro (1st generation)
features: First-generation AirPods Pro offer Active Noise Cancellation and include silicone ear tips in three sizes. The earbuds are rated IPX4 for sweat and water resistance during non-water activities.
usage: Use the earbuds for listening and calls, with the silicone tips fitted comfortably. Use Active Noise Cancellation to reduce surrounding noise.
